facts.fact: The U.S. landscaping services industry is a $153 billion market growing 6% annually, according to IBISWorld (third-party figure cited by AdWave).
facts.quote: The U.S. landscaping services industry is a $153 billion market, growing 6% annually (IBISWorld, 2024).

facts.fact: The U.S. landscaping services market has more than 600,000 companies competing for residential, commercial, and municipal work, per AdWave's article.
facts.quote: More than 600,000 companies compete for residential, commercial, and municipal work.

facts.fact: AdWave states that March through June accounts for 70% of annual new customer acquisition for most landscaping companies.
facts.quote: March-June is 70% of annual new customer acquisition for most companies.

facts.fact: AdWave estimates a customer acquired for a $75 one-time mow is worth roughly $2,000-$4,000 per year if converted to a weekly or biweekly maintenance plan.
facts.quote: A customer acquired for a $75 one-time mow is worth roughly $2,000-$4,000 per year if you convert them to a weekly or biweekly maintenance plan.

facts.quote: According to BrightLocal's 2024 Local Consumer Survey, 87% of consumers read online reviews before choosing a local service provider

facts.fact: According to Google's internal data, 76% of local searches result in a business visit inside 24 hours (Google, 2023).
facts.quote: According to Google's internal data, 76% of local searches result in a business visit inside 24 hours (Google, 2023).

facts.fact: Local Services Ads for landscaping cost $15-$50 per lead, and advertisers pay only when someone contacts them, per AdWave.
facts.quote: Leads cost $15-$50 each for landscaping, and you only pay when someone contacts you.

facts.fact: AdWave recommends single-location landscaping companies budget $1,200-$4,000 per month for Google Ads during peak season (March-July).
facts.quote: Single-location landscaping companies should budget $1,200-$4,000 per month during peak season (March-July)

facts.fact: AdWave recommends single-location landscaping companies budget $500-$1,500 per month for Google Ads off-season.
facts.quote: scale down to $500-$1,500 off-season.

facts.fact: AdWave states CPCs for lawn care on Google Ads run $5-$18 depending on market.
facts.quote: CPCs for lawn care run $5-$18 depending on market, with lower costs in smaller metros.

facts.fact: AdWave expects Google Ads cost per qualified lead for landscaping of $25-$65, with close rates of 30-45% for recurring service.
facts.quote: Expect cost per qualified lead of $25-$65, with close rates of 30-45% for recurring service.

facts.quote: Meta Business data shows that video ads produce 1.2x higher engagement than static images

facts.fact: AdWave states CPMs run $8-$18 for locally targeted audiences on Meta for landscaping.
